concerns.text: The plan uses *residual permutation* as one of the dual null‑simulation strategies for estimating Type I error of t‑tests/ANOVA. Residual permutation assumes exchangeability of model residuals and is typically appropriate for regression‑type statistics, not for simple two‑sample t‑tests or one‑way ANOVA on transformed data. Applying it here may yield biased Type I error estimates, making the validation of transformation effects methodologically unsound.
